# Schema `audit`

Append-only audit trail of every create, change and delete, partitioned by month (DB-08).

## `audit.audit_events`

Append-only trail of every data change and security event: who did what to which record, with before and after values. Partitioned by month on created_at. Secrets are never recorded. _(row-level security, partitioned by month)_

| Column | Type | Null | Default | References | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | uuid | no | `uuid_v7()` |  | Event id, a UUIDv7. With created_at forms the primary key (partitioned tables need the partition key in it). |
| `created_at` | timestamp with time zone | no | `now()` |  | When it happened (UTC); also the partition key. |
| `created_by` | uuid | yes |  | `core.users` | User who did it; null for system jobs and failed sign-ins for unknown accounts. |
| `action` | text | no |  |  | What happened, dotted lower case: <schema>.<table>.<create\|update\|archive\|restore\|delete> for data changes, auth.<event> for sign-in events, licence.<event> for licence events. |
| `entity_type` | text | no |  |  | Kind of record affected, e.g. core.users or core.locations. |
| `entity_id` | uuid | yes |  |  | Id of the record affected, where there is one. |
| `site_id` | uuid | yes |  |  | Site the record belongs to; null for organisation-level events (users, roles, sign-ins). Row-level security hides other sites' events. |
| `before` | jsonb | yes |  |  | [personal] Record before the change (JSON), without secrets. Null for creates and sign-in events. |
| `after` | jsonb | yes |  |  | [personal] Record after the change (JSON), without secrets, or event details. Null for deletes. |
| `ip_address` | inet | yes |  |  | [personal] IP address of the request, for sign-in events. |
